name: GenOffice
description: Edits and creates Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and PDF files with AI in a free open-source desktop suite, with a CLI and MCP server so coding agents can produce real Office files.

skills.name: Create Office Files
skills.description: Creates .docx, .xlsx, .pptx, and PDF files from Markdown, JSON tables, or page specs, keeping spreadsheet formulas live.

skills.name: Convert Documents
skills.description: Converts Markdown, HTML, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, PDF, and ODF files between formats on your machine, without uploading them.

skills.name: Build Slide Decks
skills.description: Builds a .pptx deck page by page from an outline and style sheet, then audits each slide for text overflow and overlap.

skills.name: Edit Word Documents
skills.description: Reads a .docx by block range and applies edits in place, or compares two versions and writes the changes as tracked revisions.

skills.name: Render Pages
skills.description: Renders every page or slide of a document to PNG so an agent can look at what it made before handing the file back.
